protocol.name: independent-candidates-v1
protocol.selection: 3 known development failures + 2 known successes; not a full-suite or blind result
protocol.change: Second call: feedback on current candidate vs independent generation from original source; public-only first-passing selection
protocol.unchanged: Same model, initial prompt and sampling schedule; max 2 calls, 15000 tokens, 2048 output tokens, 600s, dual public validation and rollback
protocol.limits: Both arms sample second call at temperature 0.7; distinct protocol from historic deterministic baseline; known development tasks, one run, no guaranteed diversity
protocol.order: Alternating arm order; fresh independent model requests
